sources.title: Joran van Apeldoorn, András Gilyén, Sander Gribling, and Ronald de Wolf, Quantum SDP-solvers: Better upper and lower bounds (arXiv:1705.01843v4)
sources.locator: Complete 69-page PDF read sequentially; SDP primal/dual formulation, normalization promises, finite Gibbs/trace route, MetaAlgorithm 1, Theorems 4–6, Appendices B–D and the failure/cost qualifications were inspected for QA30.

sources.title: Fernando G. S. L. Brandão and Krysta M. Svore, Quantum speed-ups for solving semidefinite programs (arXiv:1609.05537)
sources.locator: Complete 24-page PDF read sequentially; primal/dual SDP form, matrix multiplicative-weights update and source resource model were inspected as an independent SDP treatment.

sources.title: Joran van Apeldoorn, András Gilyén, Sander Gribling, and Ronald de Wolf, Convex optimization using quantum oracles (arXiv:1809.00643v4)
sources.locator: Complete 29-page PDF read sequentially; Definitions 3–4, Lemmas 14–21 and the full proof of Theorem 23 on PDF pp.5,10–16 were inspected. The theorem is membership-to-separation; the classical optimization composition is treated separately.

sources.title: M. Cerezo et al., Variational quantum algorithms (arXiv:2012.09265)
sources.locator: Complete 33-page PDF read sequentially; VQA objective and hybrid optimizer discussion, QAOA section, parameter-shift equation (7), and finite sampling/noise caveats on PDF pp.5–7 were inspected.

sources.title: Andrew M. Childs, Lecture Notes on Quantum Algorithms (17 April 2025)
sources.locator: Complete 191-page course-note PDF read sequentially; quantum algorithm access and the SDP weak-duality discussion on PDF pp.127–129 were re-inspected for QA30. This is the book/full-lecture-note treatment.
